notes: אִישׁ is realized twice — promoted to the clause's subject as *A man* and resumed as *his* on *mouth* — so both realizations are its one discontinuous unit under rule 25's resumption sentence, headed on the first; marking *his* added would leave a written nominal's second realization unaligned.
The second colon's *shall eat* is placed with the written אָכַל of the first colon under rule 34's gapping sentence rather than marked added.
